queries.sql: SELECT a."id", a."email", a."age", a."active" FROM "account" a WHERE a."id" = $1
SELECT a."id", a."email", a."age", a."active" FROM "account" a WHERE a."id" >= $1 AND a."id" < $2

SELECT a."id", a."email", (SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(p_posts_sub)) FROM (SELECT p."id", p."title" FROM "post" p WHERE p."author" = a."id") p_posts_sub) AS "posts" FROM "account" a WHERE a."id" >= $1 AND a."id" < $2
